test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Why didn’t your father accompany you?

options.text: Why didn’t you be accompanied by your father?
Why were you not accompanied by your father?
Why wasn’t your father accompanied by you?
Why have you not been accompanied by your father?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice sentences, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The tense and the question form are maintained while changing the voice from active to passive.
 
• The subject of the active sentence "**your father"** becomes the agent in the passive sentence, and **"you**" becomes the new subject.
 
• The correct structure for the passive form of a past simple question is 
 
 
• **"Why + was/were + subject + verb (past participle)?**"
 
 

Hence, the correct Passive voice is :** *Why were you not accompanied by your father?***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The use of passive voice can shift the focus of the sentence from the doer of the action to the action itself or the recipient of the action.
 
• This can be useful for emphasizing the action or for situations where the doer is unknown or less important.
